mechanism: Methylphenidate increases sympathomimetic activity and heart rate/blood pressure, which may potentiate cardiovascular stress in patients on antiplatelet therapy; clopidogrel is a CYP2D6 substrate and methylphenidate is a weak CYP2D6 inhibitor, potentially reducing clopidogrel activation.
action: Monitor cardiovascular status closely; consider alternative ADHD medication if patient has recent acute coronary syndrome or stent placement; assess bleeding risk and ensure adequate antiplatelet efficacy.
